title: Local supported comparison maps
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, and T a closed subset contained in U. Set V = X minus T. Derived restriction and R(U.ι)_* use [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every adjunction restriction ⊣ R(U.ι)_*, the unit at an object E whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T becomes invertible after restriction to each of U and V. For any left adjoint S of restriction [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], any perfect F on U [def-pc-perfect-complex] supported on T, and any map phi:S(F)→R(U.ι)_*F whose right-adjunct composed with the left-adjunction unit is the identity of F, phi becomes invertible after restriction to each of U and V.

source.place: Tag 08DF (Lemma 20.33.6), restriction computations using Tags 08FE and 08BS

proof.text: Restriction commutes with derived direct image. A supported object restricts to zero on U intersect V. Consequently direct image restricts to the original object on U and to zero on V. The unit is invertible on U, and is a morphism between zero objects on V. Changing an adjunction structure changes these maps only by natural automorphisms.

Exact extension by zero provides the left adjoint of derived restriction; uniqueness of left adjoints identifies every S with it. Its restriction on U is F with invertible unit; on V it is extension by zero of the zero restriction of F. The adjunct equation and invertible units/counits imply invertibility of phi on U; on V it is a morphism between zero objects.

theorem supported_open_pushforward_local_comparisons (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : (V : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    (∀ (adj : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
        (E : schemeDerivedCategory X),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E).val.presheaf x))) →
      ∀ W : X.Opens, W = U ∨ W = V →
        IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory.map (adj.unit.app E))) ∧
    (∀ (adj : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
        (S : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (adjS : S ⊣ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory)
        (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme), IsPerfect U.toScheme F →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj F).val.presheaf
            x))) →
      ∀ φ : S.obj F ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj F,
        adjS.unit.app F ≫ (adj.homEquiv (S.obj F) F).symm φ = 𝟙 F →
        ∀ W : X.Opens, W = U ∨ W = V →
          IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory.map φ))
